marketing_wrapper: Heavy. Speckled pastel backdrops (butter yellow, dusty rose, mauve, mustard) with die-cut photo stickers, line-drawn fruit outlines and confetti dots scattered around. 01 is pure marketing (headline in a sticker outline, rainbow-lettered 'language', serif wordmark, award laurels). 03 is a staged composition of stickers around the Cappy mascot with a black 'Talk with Cappy' pill, possibly an in-app screen but with no chrome. 02, 04, 05 and 06 show a real screen in a tilted or straight iPhone frame at about 55-65% of the image, with stickers overflowing the frame. Images are 600x1300. The sticker wrapper is itself brand evidence: it reuses the app's own output.

typography.display: Two voices: a heavy rounded geometric sans for sticker labels, set with a thick white outline ('Helado', 'Perro', 'Glace'), and a classic bold serif for dates and the wordmark ('Feb 03', 'CapWords', 'Hola'), italic serif on the camera date. Names unsure.
typography.body: custom-looking grotesque for sentences (bold Spanish line, wider grey regular translation); possibly SF for small labels ('19 Words', 'light up words'); unsure
typography.numerals: serif lining for dates ('Feb 03'); rounded sans for counters ('0/15')
typography.weights: Heavy/black sticker words, bold serif dates, bold sentence lines over regular translations
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; normal tracking; IPA transcription in grey ('/e'la.ðo/')

palette.accent_strategy: Per-content: the app chrome is light grey and near-black, and colour comes from the photographed objects and the stickers; a confetti of saturated dots (pink, purple, orange, red) marks words being lit up; orange underline highlights the target word in a sentence. Brand yellow dominates marketing.
palette.source: palette.json 05/06 (#f4f4f4 app background), 04 (#faf6f3 conversation screen), 01/03 (#ffeb76 brand yellow backdrop), 04/05 (#d4938d, #c492ad marketing backdrops); confetti and underline hues matched visually

shape.radius_language: mixed: die-cut organic sticker outlines with thick white borders, circular buttons (close, capture, menu), pill CTA, rounded camera viewfinder corner brackets
shape.borders_shadows: Thick white sticker stroke plus a soft drop shadow on every cut-out word and object; polaroid frames; chrome itself is borderless
shape.materials: Photographic die-cut stickers with paper-like shadow on flat grey; speckle paper texture in marketing; translucent circular buttons over camera

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: translucent circular buttons in camera and conversation views could be glass or plain blur
density: low: one object or one prompt per screen, a sticker shelf row at the top, lots of empty space
layout: Capture: full-screen camera with corner brackets, serif date top-left, multicolour-ringed shutter centre-bottom flanked by close and gallery buttons. Day view: serif date title + word count, a horizontal shelf of the day's stickers (unselected greyed), the selected object large in the centre with translations as stickers around it, the word and IPA below. Conversation: Cappy mascot bottom, the AI's sentence centred with the target word underlined, a progress counter 'light up words 0/15' top.
navigation: No tab bar visible. Back chevron + centred serif date title; circular close X; minimal custom chrome.
imagery_and_icons: User photos turned into die-cut stickers (ice cream, cone, tomato, dog); a pink donut mascot 'Cappy' with googly eyes and sprinkles; flag icons; outline system icons (speaker waves, chevron, close)
signature_visual_move: Every photographed object becomes a die-cut sticker with a thick white edge, labelled in an outlined rounded word sticker in each language.

direction_fit.secondary: Authored Illustration (dimensional sticker variant), with a Coach Character note (Cappy)
direction_fit.why: The output is a collectable sticker object with its own art direction, which matches both halves of the text record's tag (Texture-Era Pictographic, now merged into Authored Illustration, plus Shareable Artifact Studio). Sharing/export itself is not shown.

notes: Mixing a bookish serif (dates, wordmark) with chunky outlined sticker type is the ownable pairing. The Cappy mascot gives the AI tutor a character, a light Coach Character overlay. Rainbow-letter 'language' in the hero is marketing only.
